newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource to buy J. Baker unit.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource to buy J. Baker unit.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc. said Tuesday it agreed to acquire J. Baker Inc.'s Parade of Shoes division for undisclosed terms.
Last year, Parade of Shoes had revenues of $113 million.
Following the news, Payless' stock jumped $2.50 to $37.125 on the New York Stock Exchange, while J. Baker's stock was up 56 cents at $6.625 on the Nasdaq market.

Payless, a footwear retailer with 4,261 stores, said it will purchase Parade of Shoes stores, inventory and trademarks. Parade of Shoes sells women's footwear and accessories in 186 stores in 14 states.
Payless said it planned to operate Parade of Shoes, whose stores are primarily located in Boston, New York, Chicago, Philadelphia and Washington, as a separate division.

"We intend to maintain a distinct positioning for Parade of Shoes, serving different customer needs at higher price points than the footwear we sell through Payless ShoeSource stores," said Steven Douglass, Payless' chairman.

J. Baker operates 1,014 footwear departments in discount department stores, 459 licensed footwear departments in semi-service and full-service department and speciality apparel stores, as well as the 186 Parade of Shoes stores, 442 Casual Male Big & Tall stores, and 66 Work 'N Gear stores.
The sale is expected to be completed early this year.
